sections.title: The multiplication principle
facts: Steps in a row ("and") multiply; separate options ("or") add.
Fill the most restricted spot first: a first digit can't be $0$.

sections.title: Permutations
facts: $n$ things in a line: $n!$. Choose $k$ in order: $\frac{n!}{(n - k)!}$.
Repeated items: divide by the shuffles of each repeat, as in $\frac{5!}{2! \, 2!}$.
Round table: $(n - 1)!$. Must sit together: glue into a block, times the block's orders.

sections.title: Combinations
facts: Grid paths $a$ right and $b$ up: $\binom{a + b}{a}$. Handshakes or lines: $\binom{n}{2}$.

sections.title: Casework
facts: Split into cases that don't overlap and cover everything; add the counts.
List in a fixed order (like $a \leq b \leq c$) to avoid double counting.
Triangle sides: the two shorter sides add to more than the longest.

sections.title: Complementary counting
facts: "At least one" is the opposite of "none"; "at least two" of "zero or one".
